purpose: Estimate the paired task-outcome effect of making live Jev semantic evidence available to GPT-6 Luna on a fresh official Inspect Evals SWE-Lancer manager cohort, while preserving observable decision justification and Jev process evidence.
evaluation_unit: one official Inspect Evals SWE-Lancer swe_manager sample executed independently in a skill-only Luna control arm and a same-skill Luna plus live-Jev treatment arm

research_questions.text: Does live Jev availability change official SWE-Lancer manager proposal-selection accuracy for GPT-6 Luna relative to the same current Jev decision skill without a live Jev tool?
How many paired decisions are treatment-only correct, control-only correct, both correct, or both incorrect, and how often does the selected proposal change?
How often is Jev actually invoked, does successful Jev use preserve adequate primary context, and does Luna retain a visible justification and semantic-evidence reconciliation?
What latency, token, and reliability overhead accompanies Jev availability and successful Jev calls?

sample_policy.control: GPT-6 Luna with the exact current Jev decision-support skill installed but no live Jev bridge
sample_policy.treatment: GPT-6 Luna with the same skill plus the live host-side Jev bridge
sample_policy.selection: ascending sha256(preregistered salt + ':' + official sample_id), excluding every previously observed Agentic-Jev SWE-Lancer manager sample
sample_policy.primary_denominator: all frozen paired tasks; a missing or non-binary official arm score counts incorrect at attempt level
sample_policy.sample_size_limitation: n=30 is intended to reveal large directional effects and discordant-pair structure; it is not well powered for small effects

oracle_policy.gold_visibility: correct proposal must not be consulted for cohort selection, prompting, or arm execution; it becomes analysis evidence only after paired execution is sealed

exclusion_policy.arm_execution_failure_primary_handling: attempt-level incorrect rather than post-hoc exclusion

frozen_runtime_identity.harness: Inspect AI with upstream Inspect Evals SWE-Lancer task/scorer plus Inspect SWE codex_cli
frozen_runtime_identity.tool_transport: Inspect bridged tool; Jev executes on host
frozen_runtime_identity.api_key_location: host only; never injected into sandbox

analysis_policy.primary_effect: treatment attempt accuracy minus control attempt accuracy
analysis_policy.called_only_subset: descriptive only because Jev invocation is agent-selected
